description.narrative:
Stakeholder effects - Improved access to finance for MSMEs: Through the Project, IFC will support eligible FIs in Nicaragua and Honduras to increase access to finance for MSMEs, aimed at contributing to reducing the MSME finance gap.
Market level outcome - Competitiveness: The project will contribute to the competitiveness of MSMEs in the targeted countries through an increased funding support for the leading banking institutions. The project is expected to demonstrate to other banks and funding partners the viability of continuing to support MSMEs. The project will do so through potential technical assistance activities to improve the capacity of the Banks in serving SMEs in the countries, potentially expanding their reach into more underserved segments.

The proposed investment consists of senior unsecured loans of up to US$155 million in the aggregate for the Banks, with each loan being for a tenor of two years and the option to rollover for an additional two years for a maximum tenor of four years. IFC proposes to make an A loan to each of (i) Banco del Pais S.A.; (ii) Banco LAFISE Honduras; (iii) Banco LAFISE Bancentro; and Banco de la Produccion S.A. The proposed IFC investment will support working capital and long-term financing needs of MSMEs, including women-owned SMEs. The projects will be supported by a pooled first loss guarantee of up to US$38.75 million provided by International Development Agency IDA Private Sector Window Blended Finance Facility (IDA-PSW BFF).
